{{Quote|You call me a swindler &hellip; I prefer to consider myself a "creative financier." It sounds SO much nicer!|Drelmar Bin|<ref name="PoG2" />}}
'''Drelmar Bin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Originally a corporate employee on an industrial planet, Bin fled when it was discovered that he had been embezzling. On Korbin, he met a man who had perfected a technique of distilling [[kyrf]] fruit into an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Kyrf (liquor)|beverage]]. Bin [[Death/Legends|killed]] the man and took over his [[Kyrf plantation|plantation]].
